panels.description: Two local HTTP GET probes each minute. Measures the full response over the local port; it does not measure all client requests.

panels.title: Active and waiting jobs

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds per second. 100% equals one fully used core.

panels.description: Unique size is based on checksum and metadata; this is not physical disk usage.

panels.title: Inventory trends • history since collection began
Photo and video inventory
panels.description: Actual sampled inventory. History starts when this collector was enabled; no reconstructed historical counts.

panels.title: Original references and unique content
panels.description: References count ownership records. Unique content groups checksums. Sharing access does not add an ownership record.

panels.title: Original size and unique logical size
panels.description: Logical sizes from known original metadata; not physical NAS consumption.

panels.description: Accounts with known originals and no additions show zero. Original size is based on available file-size metadata.

panels.title: Photos and videos by account
panels.description: Optional account labels must be enabled in the private collector config. Counts are per account; shared access does not create another original.

panels.description: Sum of known original byte sizes, including duplicate content owned by different accounts.

panels.title: Active jobs
panels.description: Retained failed/completed jobs are current queue records, not lifetime counters. Zero means a successful empty queue read.

panels.title: Waiting jobs
panels.description: Retained failed/completed jobs are current queue records, not lifetime counters. Zero means a successful empty queue read.

panels.title: Retained failed jobs
panels.description: Retained failed/completed jobs are current queue records, not lifetime counters. Zero means a successful empty queue read.

panels.title: Paused queues
panels.description: Retained failed/completed jobs are current queue records, not lifetime counters. Zero means a successful empty queue read.

panels.title: Missing previews
panels.description: Active assets without an asset_file preview record. Format support and processing state affect this count; it alone does not establish a media or backup error.

panels.title: Unexpired session records
panels.description: Stored session records with no explicit expiry or an expiry in the future. This is not the number of people currently online.

targets.expr: ((sum by(immich_host) (immich_inventory_assets{immich_host=~"$host",state="active"})) and on(immich_host) (immich_collector_success{immich_host=~"$host",component="inventory"} == 1) and on(immich_host) (time()-immich_collector_timestamp_seconds{immich_host=~"$host",component="inventory"}<180)) - on(immich_host) ((immich_inventory_unique_originals{immich_host=~"$host"}) and on(immich_host) (immich_collector_success{immich_host=~"$host",component="inventory"} == 1) and on(immich_host) (time()-immich_collector_timestamp_seconds{immich_host=~"$host",component="inventory"}<180))

panels.title: Protection • native backup and cloud coverage
Workflow state
panels.description: Deferred means waiting for a prerequisite or coordination lock. It is not a completed capture or failure. Last success remains independent.

panels.title: Container restart count
panels.description: Docker restart counter for this container, not lifetime service failures; recreating a container resets the count.

panels.title: Repository operations / second
panels.description: Instrumented repository calls, not HTTP requests.

panels.title: Mean repository operation latency
panels.description: Native durations are milliseconds. No observations means no latency sample; no artificial zero is inserted.

panels.title: Filesystem free space
panels.description: NAS mounts may share the same underlying pool; do not sum their capacity.

options.content: The collector samples inventory, queues, backup state and the local API every minute. Those graphs show gaps after a failed read or after three minutes without a fresh sample. The response time graph measures the two local probe requests. Repository operations have their own charts. Counts include active originals and show trash separately. Logical content size is distinct from NAS disk usage. Account labels are opt-in. Backup history and verification timestamps come from the existing backup status records.
